description: Object form of commands: command name (becomes the slash-command name) to its definition. Each command needs exactly one of source or content.

source.description: Path to the command markdown file, relative to the plugin root (starts with ./).

content.description: Inline markdown content for the command.

argumentHint.description: Hint for command arguments, for example [file].

allowedTools.description: Tools allowed when the command runs.

x-note: Accepted by CLI 2.1.281 and present in the SchemaStore baseline; not in the current docs component-path table.
